top_signals.title: Turkey Snubs Smaller Investors After Scandal Sparks Liquidations
top_signals.summary: Turkey’s market regulator raised the threshold for qualified investors fivefold in the wake of a fund rout that rocked capital markets and erased billions of dollars of equity value.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
